purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry access review.
assessment: Official local municipality and nationwide U Maps plot-map scope documented; no anonymously accessible feature schema or point geometry was verified. The public service documentation describes interactive map layers but does not expose a feature API/schema in the reviewed sources. No login, account, or personal lookup was used.
registryAssessment: The Ministry’s official Tabuk Municipality branch page identifies the local municipal authority. Its Urban Maps service states that U Maps covers urban data across Saudi cities and displays land plots and related details to the public. This establishes a national plot-map service for the city by its stated all-city scope, but no Tabuk-specific layer/schema or WUP-point feature response was verified.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Ministry page identifies the Tabuk Municipality branch and its location.
Official Urban Maps service documentation says the service covers all Saudi urban areas and includes land plots and plot details, free for individuals and without documents.
Arabic official service page gives the same U Maps service scope and workflow.
Balady service channel linked from the official Ministry page.
